name: August festival
text: August festival is the dictionary name for a Celtic feast of early August. The work sends the reader who searches this headword to its own entry under Lughnasa. The feast thanked the god Lugh at the first of the harvest. Ireland and the Isle of Man both kept it at the close of summer.

attributes.attribute: cross-reference for the feast of Lughnasa

okr.objective: Record the August festival as the feast of Lughnasa.
key_results: Set the feast at the start of August.
